SELECT 
  ts_doy,
  ROUND(AVG(CAST(wtmp_c AS FLOAT)), 2) as avg_wtmp_c,
  ROUND(AVG(CAST(wtmp_c AS FLOAT)) * 9/5 + 32, 1) as avg_wtmp_f
FROM pier
WHERE ts_season = 6 AND ts_doy >= 160 AND ts_doy <= 182
GROUP BY ts_doy
ORDER BY ts_doy DESC
LIMIT 25

SELECT 
  fish_date_doy,
  cls,
  COUNT(*) as boat_count,
  ROUND(AVG(CAST(yt AS FLOAT) / CAST(anglers AS FLOAT)), 3) as avg_yt_per_angler,
  SUM(CAST(yt AS FLOAT)) as total_yt
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_season = 6 AND fish_date_doy >= 160 AND fish_date_doy <= 182 AND yt IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY fish_date_doy, cls
ORDER BY fish_date_doy DESC, avg_yt_per_angler DESC
